acceptable_use_policy: Data is used for law enforcement purposes only. Data is owned by Wise County VA SO and is never sold to 3rd parties.
prohibited_uses: Immigration enforcement, traffic enforcement, harassment or intimidation, usage based solely on a protected class (i.e. race, sex, religion), Personal use.
access_policy: All system access requires a valid reason and is stored indefinitely.
hotlist_policy: Hotlist hits are required to be human verified prior to action.
overview: Wise County VA SO uses Flock Safety technology to capture objective evidence without compromising on individual privacy. Wise County VA SO utilizes retroactive search to solve crimes after they've occurred. Additionally, Wise County VA SO utilizes real time alerting of hotlist vehicles to capture wanted criminals. In an effort to ensure proper usage and guardrails are in place, they have made the below policies and usage statistics available to the public.
